name: harbor-farm
description: Grow session-native crops and visit friends while coding agents run.

interface.shortDescription: Play a shared Farm while agents run.
interface.longDescription: Harbor Farm turns metadata-only Agent sessions into mystery crops, shared plots, neighbor visits, and limited crop foraging without sending prompts, outputs, tool arguments, or file contents.
defaultPrompt: Open my Harbor Farm and show what is growing.
Visit a Farm neighbor with me while this task runs.
Show the session crops my agents have discovered.
